A = oₜ，B = oₜ₊₁，R = recon。oₜ / oₜ₊₁ 分别表示: A = oₜ, B = oₜ₊₁, R = recon. The observations oₜ and oₜ₊₁ are consecutive frames; recon is the reconstruction. S, E, and P denote SSIM, MSE, and PSNR. Base formulas are listed below.
每行、每个 Head 内的分项成功率取等权算术平均。LIBERO / LIBER: For each experiment and head, success rates are averaged with equal weights: 4 components for LIBERO / LIBERO-Plus and 2 for RoboTwin. The DAP/LAP mean equally weights the two head means for the same experiment. Original zeros are retained, and different experiments are not aggregated. If either head is missing, their combined mean is also missing.
Pearson 衡量线性关系；Spearman 衡量单调关系，先对两列分别排名，: Pearson measures linear association. Spearman measures monotonic association by ranking each variable, assigning average ranks to ties, and computing Pearson correlation between the ranks.
x 为代理指标，y 为平均成功率（0–1），使用带截距的普通最小二乘拟合。图中纵: The proxy metric is x and mean success rate (0–1) is y. Ordinary least squares includes an intercept. The chart displays success rates as percentages; the fitted equation uses the original 0–1 scale.
每项指标只使用成功率和指标同时有效的实验，n 因而可能不同。少于 2 个样本或任: Each metric uses only experiments with valid values for both the metric and success rate, so n may vary. Correlations are undefined with fewer than 2 valid pairs or a constant variable. Interpret small samples cautiously; correlation does not imply causation.
Mean ratio / Gain 按源表中的行级公式计算，不等同于逐样本比值或: Mean ratio / Gain follows the row-level formulas in the source worksheet; these values are not necessarily averages of per-sample ratios or gains. Metrics missing from the source remain missing.
LIBERO-Plus 成功率与同一实验的 LIBERO 代理指标配对；原表未单: LIBERO-Plus success rates are paired with LIBERO proxy metrics from the same experiment. The source worksheet does not provide separate LIBERO-Plus proxy metrics.
每个 Head 的原始分项等权取算术平均，零值参与平均。: For each head, the original component values are averaged with equal weights, including zeros.
recon：原表中的重建图像；仅凭工作簿无法确定其预测目标、时间对齐及生成方式。: recon: the reconstructed image in the source worksheet. The workbook alone does not specify its prediction target, temporal alignment, or generation process.
图像有效取值范围（data_range），如归一化图像常取 1，8 位图像常取: The image data_range, commonly 1 for normalized images or 255 for 8-bit images. The worksheet does not specify this setting.
参与均方误差计算的像素/通道标量总数。: The total number of pixel/channel scalar values used to compute MSE.
平均每个像素/通道的平方差，即误差信号的平均能量；受亮度范围和像素配准影响。0: The mean squared difference per pixel/channel, or mean error-signal energy. It depends on intensity range and pixel alignment. Zero means identical values; lower values indicate greater similarity. Units are squared pixel values.
以有效像素范围的平方为参照、用分贝表示的误差大小。固定 L 时越大表示 MSE: Error expressed in decibels relative to the squared image data range. For fixed L, higher PSNR means lower MSE. When MSE=0, theoretical PSNR is +∞. PSNR has no fixed upper bound of 100 dB.
结合局部亮度、对比度及结构的一致程度。μ 为局部均值、σ² 为局部方差、σ_XY: Combines local luminance, contrast, and structural agreement. μ is the local mean, σ² the local variance, and σ_XY the covariance. Values closer to 1 indicate greater similarity; negative values are possible. Window, channel, covariance, and data_range settings affect the result and are not specified in the worksheet.
从潜在动作 z 线性预测物理动作 a 的均方误差。项目 train_stage1: Mean squared error when linearly predicting physical actions a from latent actions z. The project file train_stage1_eval.py uses nn.MSELoss() and reports eval_linear_latent_action_mean_mse.
MSE 越小越好；勾选探针分数后使用 −MSE，越大越好。: Lower MSE is better. With Probe score enabled, the value is −MSE and higher is better.
从潜在动作 z 非线性预测物理动作 a 的均方误差。项目 train_stage: Mean squared error when nonlinearly predicting physical actions a from latent actions z. By default, train_stage1_eval.py uses two ReLU hidden layers of width 128 and a linear output layer, evaluated with nn.MSELoss().
相邻观测的结构相似度，反映场景随时间的视觉变化。: Structural similarity between consecutive observations, reflecting visual change over time.
越大表示相邻帧更相似、视觉变化更小；不是必然越大成功率越高。: Higher values mean more similar consecutive frames and less visual change, not necessarily higher success rates.
重建图像与当前观测在局部结构、亮度和对比度上的一致程度。: Agreement between the reconstruction and current observation in local structure, luminance, and contrast.
越大表示重建更接近当前帧；是否更好取决于重建目标。: Higher values mean the reconstruction is closer to the current frame. Whether this is better depends on the reconstruction target.
重建图像与下一时刻观测在局部结构、亮度和对比度上的一致程度。: Agreement between the reconstruction and next observation in local structure, luminance, and contrast.
越大表示重建更接近下一帧；若目标为下一帧，通常表示结构重建更准确。: Higher values mean the reconstruction is closer to the next frame. If that is the target, this generally indicates more accurate structural reconstruction.
相邻观测的平均像素平方变化，衡量时间变化的像素误差能量。: Mean squared pixel change between consecutive observations, measuring the pixel-error energy of temporal change.
越小表示相邻帧像素变化越小，不直接等同于任务表现更好。: Lower values mean less pixel change between consecutive frames, not necessarily better task performance.
重建图像相对当前观测的平均像素平方偏差。: Mean squared pixel difference between the reconstruction and current observation.
越小表示重建更接近当前帧；是否更好取决于重建目标。: Lower values mean the reconstruction is closer to the current frame. Whether this is better depends on the reconstruction target.
重建图像相对下一时刻观测的平均像素平方偏差。: Mean squared pixel difference between the reconstruction and next observation.
越小表示重建更接近下一帧；若目标为下一帧，通常表示像素误差更小。: Lower values mean the reconstruction is closer to the next frame. If that is the target, this generally indicates lower pixel error.
相邻观测的像素差异在分贝尺度下的表示。: Pixel differences between consecutive observations expressed on a decibel scale.
固定 L 时越大表示相邻帧像素变化越小。: For fixed L, higher values mean less pixel change between consecutive frames.
重建图像相对当前观测的像素误差在分贝尺度下的表示。: Pixel error between the reconstruction and current observation expressed on a decibel scale.
固定 L 时越大表示重建更接近当前帧。: For fixed L, higher values mean the reconstruction is closer to the current frame.
重建图像相对下一时刻观测的像素误差在分贝尺度下的表示。: Pixel error between the reconstruction and next observation expressed on a decibel scale.
固定 L 时越大表示重建更接近下一帧。: For fixed L, higher values mean the reconstruction is closer to the next frame.
比较重建与下一帧、当前帧的结构相似程度。: Compares reconstruction similarity to the next frame versus the current frame.
当分母为正时，>1 表示对下一帧的 SSIM 高于对当前帧的 SSIM。: With a positive denominator, >1 means higher SSIM with the next frame than with the current frame.
按原表单元格公式。分母为 0 时无定义；接近 0 时不稳定，负分母时不能按通常的: Uses the original worksheet formula. Undefined at a zero denominator and unstable near zero. A negative denominator prevents the usual multiplicative interpretation.
比较重建相对下一帧与当前帧的两个 PSNR 数值。: Compares reconstruction PSNR relative to the next frame and current frame.
当分母为正时，>1 表示下一帧比较的 PSNR 更高。: With a positive denominator, >1 means higher PSNR for the next-frame comparison.
按原表单元格公式。这是两个 dB 数值的比，不是信号功率比或误差能量比；分母为: Uses the original worksheet formula. This is a ratio of two dB values, not a signal-power or error-energy ratio. It is undefined at a zero denominator and depends on L and normalization.
重建相对下一帧的误差能量，是相对当前帧误差能量的多少倍。: Reconstruction error energy relative to the next frame, as a multiple of the error energy relative to the current frame.
分母为正时，<1 表示重建在像素误差上更接近下一帧。: With a positive denominator, <1 means the reconstruction is closer to the next frame in pixel error.
按原表单元格公式。分母为 0 时无定义，接近 0 时不稳定。该比值小并不保证绝对: Uses the original worksheet formula. Undefined at a zero denominator and unstable near zero. A small ratio does not guarantee a small absolute error.
把当前帧直接当作下一帧的基线与重建比较，衡量相对于 SSIM 理想值 1 的可提: Compares the reconstruction against using the current frame as the next-frame prediction, measuring how much of the gap to ideal SSIM (1) is recovered.
分母为正时，>0 优于当前帧基线，0 与基线相同，1 表示 S(B,R)=1。: With a positive denominator, >0 improves on the current-frame baseline, 0 matches it, and 1 means S(B,R)=1.
按原表单元格公式。基线 SSIM=1 时无定义，接近 1 时数值敏感。: Uses the original worksheet formula. Undefined at baseline SSIM=1 and sensitive near 1.
原表用 100 dB 作为参考值，将重建相对当前帧基线的 PSNR 提升归一化。: The source worksheet uses 100 dB as a reference to normalize PSNR improvement over the current-frame baseline.
基线<100 dB 时，>0 表示提升，0 表示不变；1 表示达到表中 100: For a baseline <100 dB, >0 means improvement, 0 means no change, and 1 reaches the worksheet reference of 100 dB.
严格沿用原表公式。100 dB 是此工作簿的约定，非 PSNR 理论上限；基线=: Follows the original worksheet formula exactly. The 100 dB reference is a workbook convention, not a theoretical PSNR limit. Undefined at a baseline of 100; the sign interpretation reverses above 100.
相比把当前帧直接当作下一帧，重建减少了多大比例的像素平方误差。: The fraction of squared pixel error removed by the reconstruction compared with using the current frame as the next-frame prediction.
基线误差>0 时，>0 表示改善，0 表示不变，1 表示重建误差为 0，<0 表: For baseline error >0, >0 means improvement, 0 means no change, 1 means zero reconstruction error, and <0 means worse performance.
按原表单元格公式。基线 MSE=0 时无定义，接近 0 时数值敏感。: Uses the original worksheet formula. Undefined at baseline MSE=0 and sensitive near zero.
原表 Mean ratio/Gain 的单行公式是对该行已经给出的指标值做比值/: The original Mean ratio/Gain formulas operate on metric values already present in each row. Without per-image raw values, they cannot be assumed to be averages of per-sample ratios or gains.
若随后对 head 的多行数值求平均，得到的是这些行级派生指标的平均；通常不等于: Averaging these values across head rows gives an average of row-level derived metrics. This generally differs from computing a ratio or gain after averaging the base metrics.
每个 head 的平均成功率采用原表有效成功率的等权平均；如果各任务试验次数不同: Each head mean equally weights the valid success rates in the source worksheet. If tasks have different trial counts, this may differ from pooled successful trials divided by total trials.
LIBERO-Plus 成功率按用户选择与同配置的 LIBERO 代理指标配对。: For the selected configuration, LIBERO-Plus success rates are paired with LIBERO proxy metrics. This pairing must be stated explicitly; these are not independently measured LIBERO-Plus proxy metrics.
SSIM、MSE、PSNR 度量视觉相似性或误差，不直接度量任务是否成功；相关方: SSIM, MSE, and PSNR measure visual similarity or error, not task success directly. Correlation direction is determined by the data; correlation does not imply causation.
度量指标 x 与成功率 y 的线性关系，范围 [-1,1]；正值同向，负值反向，: Measures linear association between metric x and success rate y, in [-1,1]. Positive values indicate the same direction, negative values the opposite direction, and 0 no linear correlation.
对离群值敏感。任一变量为常量时无定义；至少需要 2 对有效值，只有 2 个点时: Sensitive to outliers and undefined for a constant variable. At least 2 valid pairs are required; |r|=1 with only 2 points has little interpretive value.
度量单调关系，即指标排序升高时成功率排序是否倾向升高；不要求关系为直线，范围 [: Measures monotonic association: whether success-rate ranks tend to increase with metric ranks. A straight-line relationship is not required. Values lie in [-1,1].
常量变量时无定义。无并列秩才可用 1−6Σd_i²/[n(n²−1)] 简式。若: Undefined for constant variables. The shortcut 1−6Σd_i²/[n(n²−1)] applies only without ties. SciPy p-value approximations may be unreliable for small samples; a permutation test can be used.
以代理指标 x 为横轴、head 平均成功率 y 为纵轴，选择使纵向平方残差和最: Fits a line minimizing squared vertical residuals, with proxy metric x on the horizontal axis and head mean success rate y on the vertical axis. For simple OLS with an intercept and nonconstant y, R²=r².
x 为常量时斜率不能拟合；y 为常量时 R² 无定义。拟合是描述性关系，预测值可: The slope cannot be fitted when x is constant; R² is undefined when y is constant. The fit is descriptive and can predict values outside the valid success-rate range, so extrapolation is not advised.
Wang 等（2004）：SSIM 原论文: Wang et al. (2004): original SSIM paper
指标和成功率均为常量: Both metric and success rate are constant
指标须为空白或绝对值不超过 1e100 的有限数值: The metric must be blank or a finite number with absolute value at most 1e100
成功率必须为 0–1 或空白: Success rate must be between 0 and 1, or blank
